title: Cookie Policy
metaDescription: Learn how Lizzdo Media uses essential cookies, performance tracking, and analytics to optimize your website experience.
content:
### 1. What Are Cookies
Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help web platforms function smoothly, remember preferences, and analyze user engagement.

### 2. Categories of Cookies We Use
- Essential Cookies: Necessary for basic website security, navigation, and state persistence.
- Analytics & Performance: Used only when enabled to measure visitor counts and traffic sources (Google Analytics 4).
- Preference Cookies: Store your preferred display settings and cookie consent state.

### 3. Managing Your Cookie Preferences
You can adjust your cookie settings at any time using our on-screen cookie preferences or via your browser configuration.
